title: Contact intelligence: the same $5M engagement
tags: analytics contact driver transcripts knowledge management 5m 700k accelerator hours savings
text: This is the same sole-source $5M engagement included in Charlie’s annual portfolio, not a separate $1.5M engagement. He delivered it in 16 weeks with seven specialists at 34% margin after discovery uncovered manual tagging and a fragmented knowledge process. Call-spike analysis fell from 1–2 weeks to minutes. The solution combined GenAI transcript tagging, human review, knowledge-gap detection, knowledge-management workflows, natural-language SQL, hybrid search, and forecasting. Eight of 10 contact-driver staff moved to AI experience roles, representing about $800K annual capacity. A plan to halve a $10M/year knowledge workload represented $5M projected annual capacity, not realized savings. The $700K accelerator sold to two more clients through RFPs.
